units.name: public-api
units.description: The top-level `fastapi` package namespace. It carries no logic of its own: it re-exports the public classes and functions defined in the framework's internal modules (the FastAPI app class, the router, parameter declarations, exceptions, request/response types) so application authors can write `import fastapi` or `from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends` without knowing the internal file layout.
units.role: Stable public import surface for the whole framework.

units.name: cli
units.description: Wraps the optional `fastapi-cli` companion package to provide the `fastapi` command and the `python -m fastapi` entry point, used to run and develop FastAPI applications from a terminal (for example `fastapi dev` / `fastapi run`, which start a local uvicorn server).
units.role: Command-line entry point for running FastAPI apps.

entrypoints.name: main
entrypoints.plain: Delegates to fastapi_cli's main(); if the optional fastapi-cli package is not installed, prints an install hint and raises RuntimeError instead.

effects.description: main() delegates to fastapi_cli's CLI, which starts a uvicorn server process to serve the user's application (fastapi_cli is an external optional dependency, not analyzed here).

units.name: application-core
units.description: Defines the `FastAPI` class, the top-level ASGI application object end users instantiate. It wires together routing, dependency-driven exception handling, OpenAPI schema generation, the interactive docs UI, and middleware into one configurable app, and exposes the familiar decorator-based methods such as get(), post(), websocket(), and include_router().
units.role: The application object that ties every other unit together.

entrypoints.name: FastAPI
entrypoints.plain: Create and configure a FastAPI application: register routes, middleware, and exception handlers, and generate the OpenAPI schema and docs UI.

entrypoints.name: openapi
entrypoints.plain: Builds and caches the application's OpenAPI schema on first access.

entrypoints.name: include_router
entrypoints.plain: Mounts all the routes of an APIRouter onto this application, optionally under a prefix.

entrypoints.name: websocket
entrypoints.plain: Decorator that registers a function as a WebSocket endpoint.

entrypoints.name: get
entrypoints.plain: Decorator that registers a function as an HTTP GET path operation.

effects.description: The docstring for the middleware()/add_middleware() helpers on FastAPI includes an example HTTP-timing middleware that calls time.time(); picked up by plain-text scanning of the file, though it is documentation, not code this unit executes.

units.name: routing
units.description: Implements FastAPI's HTTP and WebSocket routing layer. APIRoute and APIWebSocketRoute wrap Starlette's routes to run dependency injection, request validation, and response serialization around each endpoint function; APIRouter groups and includes routes (including helpers for serving a compiled single-page-app frontend); and request_response()/get_request_handler()/get_websocket_app() build the actual ASGI request-handling closures that Starlette calls per request.
units.role: Turns endpoint functions into ASGI request handlers.

entrypoints.name: APIRouter
entrypoints.plain: Groups path operations and (optionally nested) sub-routers under a shared prefix, dependencies, and configuration.

entrypoints.name: APIRoute
entrypoints.plain: A single registered path operation: holds its dependant tree, response model, and the compiled request handler.

entrypoints.name: APIWebSocketRoute
entrypoints.plain: A single registered WebSocket path operation.

entrypoints.name: get_request_handler
entrypoints.plain: Builds the async ASGI callable for one HTTP path operation: solves dependencies, calls the endpoint, and serializes the response.

entrypoints.name: get_websocket_app
entrypoints.plain: Builds the async ASGI callable for one WebSocket path operation.

entrypoints.name: serialize_response
entrypoints.plain: Validates and serializes an endpoint's return value against its declared response_model.

entrypoints.name: request_response
entrypoints.plain: Adapts a plain request handler coroutine into a Starlette-compatible ASGI application.

effects.description: APIRouter can serve a compiled single-page-app frontend from disk via internal _FrontendStaticFiles/_FrontendRoute helpers, which resolve directories and read index.html fallbacks from the filesystem (os.path.*).
The frontend static-file resolver reads the FASTAPI_ENV environment variable to decide whether a missing frontend build directory is tolerated (development) or raises an error.

units.name: dependency-injection
units.description: Implements FastAPI's dependency-injection engine. It introspects endpoint and dependency callables' signatures (get_dependant) to build a Dependant tree describing required path/query/header/cookie/body parameters and nested sub-dependencies, and resolves that tree at request time (solve_dependencies), including per-request caching, security-scope tracking, and generator-based dependencies with teardown via an AsyncExitStack.
units.role: Resolves declared parameters and sub-dependencies for each request.

entrypoints.name: Dependant
entrypoints.plain: Describes everything one callable (endpoint or dependency) needs: its path/query/header/cookie/body params and its own sub-dependencies.

entrypoints.name: get_dependant
entrypoints.plain: Inspects a callable's signature and builds its Dependant tree, recursing into Depends()-declared sub-dependencies.

entrypoints.name: solve_dependencies
entrypoints.plain: Given an incoming request and a Dependant tree, resolves every parameter and sub-dependency value, calling generator dependencies and registering their teardown.

entrypoints.name: get_parameterless_sub_dependant
entrypoints.plain: Builds a Dependant for a bare Depends() with no explicit parameters, used for router-level dependencies.

entrypoints.name: get_typed_signature
entrypoints.plain: Returns a callable's inspect.Signature with string annotations resolved to real types.

entrypoints.name: request_params_to_args
entrypoints.plain: Extracts and validates query/header/cookie/path parameter values from an incoming request.

entrypoints.name: request_body_to_args
entrypoints.plain: Extracts and validates the request body (JSON or form) into the endpoint's declared body parameters.

entrypoints.name: get_flat_params
entrypoints.plain: Flattens a Dependant tree into the list of non-body fields used to build the OpenAPI parameters list.

entrypoints.name: SolvedDependency
entrypoints.plain: The result of solve_dependencies(): resolved values, errors, and background tasks collected while solving.

units.name: params
units.description: Defines how endpoint parameters are declared. params.py provides the Param/Body field-info subclasses (Path, Query, Header, Cookie, Body, Form, File, Depends, Security) that carry validation rules and OpenAPI metadata; param_functions.py exposes the public factory functions of the same names that users call in function signatures, such as `Query(default=None)`, which construct and return instances of those classes.
units.role: Declares the vocabulary applications use to describe endpoint parameters.

entrypoints.name: Path
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring a path parameter.

entrypoints.name: Query
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring a query parameter.

entrypoints.name: Header
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring a header parameter.

entrypoints.name: Cookie
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring a cookie parameter.

entrypoints.name: Body
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring (part of) a request body.

entrypoints.name: Form
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring a form field.

entrypoints.name: File
entrypoints.plain: Public factory for declaring an uploaded file field.

entrypoints.name: Depends
entrypoints.plain: Public factory that marks a parameter as resolved by calling another callable (a dependency).

entrypoints.name: Security
entrypoints.plain: Public factory like Depends(), additionally declaring required OAuth2/security scopes.

entrypoints.name: Depends
entrypoints.plain: The field-info object created by the Depends() factory; carries the dependency callable and cache flag.

entrypoints.name: Security
entrypoints.plain: The field-info object created by the Security() factory; carries required OAuth2 scopes.

entrypoints.name: Query
entrypoints.plain: The field-info object created by the Query() factory; carries validation and OpenAPI metadata for a query parameter.

entrypoints.name: Body
entrypoints.plain: The field-info object created by the Body() factory.

entrypoints.name: ParamTypes
entrypoints.plain: Enum of the parameter locations: path, query, header, cookie.

units.name: request-response
units.description: Provides FastAPI's request/response vocabulary: thin re-exports of Starlette's Request, WebSocket and WebSocketDisconnect; FastAPI-specific Response subclasses (UJSONResponse, ORJSONResponse); the EventSourceResponse/ServerSentEvent types and format_sse_event() helper used for Server-Sent Events streaming; BackgroundTasks for post-response work; and shared data types such as UploadFile and the Default/DefaultPlaceholder 'was this explicitly set' sentinel.
units.role: Shared request/response, streaming, and background-task types used across the framework.

entrypoints.name: Request
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's Request, the incoming HTTP request object handed to endpoints and dependencies.

entrypoints.name: Response
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's base Response class.

entrypoints.name: JSONResponse
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's JSONResponse.

entrypoints.name: HTMLResponse
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's HTMLResponse, used to serve the docs UI pages.

entrypoints.name: StreamingResponse
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's StreamingResponse, the base class EventSourceResponse builds on.

entrypoints.name: BackgroundTasks
entrypoints.plain: A queue of callables to run after the response has been sent to the client.

entrypoints.name: UploadFile
entrypoints.plain: Represents an uploaded file parameter, wrapping a SpooledTemporaryFile.

entrypoints.name: Default
entrypoints.plain: Wraps a default value in a DefaultPlaceholder so FastAPI can tell an explicit value from an unset default.

entrypoints.name: DefaultPlaceholder
entrypoints.plain: Marker object produced by Default(); code can check whether the wrapped default was ever overridden.

entrypoints.name: _Unset
entrypoints.plain: Sentinel DefaultPlaceholder instance used as 'no value given' across the params/openapi units.

entrypoints.name: WebSocket
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's WebSocket connection object.

entrypoints.name: WebSocketDisconnect
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's exception raised when a WebSocket client disconnects.

entrypoints.name: EventSourceResponse
entrypoints.plain: A StreamingResponse subclass that formats an async iterable of ServerSentEvent/plain values as an SSE stream.

entrypoints.name: ServerSentEvent
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for one Server-Sent Event (data/event/id/retry fields) with SSE-format validation.

entrypoints.name: format_sse_event
entrypoints.plain: Serializes a ServerSentEvent (or raw value) into the `data: ...` wire format.

entrypoints.name: _SSE_EVENT_SCHEMA
entrypoints.plain: The canonical OpenAPI schema fragment describing an SSE event, reused when documenting SSE endpoints.

entrypoints.name: _PING_INTERVAL
entrypoints.plain: Default seconds between SSE keep-alive pings.

entrypoints.name: KEEPALIVE_COMMENT
entrypoints.plain: The raw SSE comment bytes sent as a keep-alive ping.

effects.description: background.py's BackgroundTasks docstring contains a usage example that calls open() to write a log file; detected by plain-text scanning of the file though it is documentation, not code this unit executes.

units.name: encoding
units.description: Implements jsonable_encoder(), which recursively converts arbitrary Python values (Pydantic models, dataclasses, datetimes, Decimals, sets, enums, UUIDs, paths, and more) into plain JSON-compatible types (dict/list/str/int/float/bool/None), respecting field inclusion/exclusion options. It is the shared conversion step behind response serialization, request-validation error payloads, and default JSON responses.
units.role: Converts framework and application objects into JSON-serializable data.

entrypoints.name: jsonable_encoder
entrypoints.plain: Recursively converts a value into JSON-compatible primitives (dict/list/str/int/float/bool/None).

entrypoints.name: generate_encoders_by_class_tuples
entrypoints.plain: Builds a lookup from a value's type to the custom encoder function that should serialize it.

effects.description: Imports pathlib.Path/PurePath purely to recognize and stringify filesystem-path values passed to it; the module never opens files itself, but the literal 'pathlib' import text is detected by plain-text scanning.

units.name: exceptions
units.description: Defines FastAPI's exception types (HTTPException, WebSocketException, the validation-error hierarchy, and internal errors like DependencyScopeError) and the default exception handlers FastAPI installs to turn those exceptions into HTTP/WebSocket responses when application code does not handle them itself.
units.role: Error types and their default HTTP/WebSocket translation.

entrypoints.name: HTTPException
entrypoints.plain: Raise to send an HTTP error response with a given status code and detail.

entrypoints.name: WebSocketException
entrypoints.plain: Raise to close a WebSocket connection with a given close code and reason.

entrypoints.name: FastAPIError
entrypoints.plain: Base class for FastAPI's own programming-error exceptions (misconfiguration, not request errors).

entrypoints.name: DependencyScopeError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when a dependency is used in a way that violates FastAPI's dependency-caching/scope rules.

entrypoints.name: RequestValidationError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when incoming request data fails validation against declared parameter/body types.

entrypoints.name: WebSocketRequestValidationError
entrypoints.plain: Like RequestValidationError, for WebSocket connection parameters.

entrypoints.name: ResponseValidationError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when an endpoint's return value fails validation against its declared response_model.

entrypoints.name: PydanticV1NotSupportedError
entrypoints.plain: Raised when application code passes a legacy Pydantic v1 model where it is no longer supported.

entrypoints.name: FastAPIDeprecationWarning
entrypoints.plain: Warning category used to flag FastAPI's own deprecated features.

entrypoints.name: EndpointContext
entrypoints.plain: TypedDict describing where an error occurred (function/file/line) for nicer error messages.

entrypoints.name: http_exception_handler
entrypoints.plain: Default handler: turns an HTTPException into a JSON (or empty) Response with the matching status code.

entrypoints.name: request_validation_exception_handler
entrypoints.plain: Default handler: turns a RequestValidationError into a 422 JSON response listing the field errors.

entrypoints.name: websocket_request_validation_exception_handler
entrypoints.plain: Default handler: closes a WebSocket with a policy-violation code when its parameters fail validation.

units.name: openapi
units.description: Generates FastAPI's OpenAPI schema from an application's routes and dependants (get_openapi/get_openapi_path), defines the Pydantic models describing the OpenAPI 3.x document itself (openapi/models.py), and renders the HTML pages that embed Swagger UI and ReDoc for interactive API documentation (openapi/docs.py).
units.role: Turns registered routes into an OpenAPI schema and interactive docs pages.

entrypoints.name: get_openapi
entrypoints.plain: Builds the full OpenAPI document dict for a set of routes, title, and version.

entrypoints.name: get_openapi_path
entrypoints.plain: Builds the OpenAPI PathItem entry (and referenced schemas) for a single route.

entrypoints.name: generate_operation_id
entrypoints.plain: Computes the default operationId for a route when none is explicitly set.

entrypoints.name: get_swagger_ui_html
entrypoints.plain: Renders the HTML page that loads Swagger UI against the app's OpenAPI JSON.

entrypoints.name: get_redoc_html
entrypoints.plain: Renders the HTML page that loads ReDoc against the app's OpenAPI JSON.

entrypoints.name: get_swagger_ui_oauth2_redirect_html
entrypoints.plain: Renders the static OAuth2 redirect page Swagger UI needs for the authorization-code flow.

entrypoints.name: OpenAPI
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for the root of an OpenAPI 3.x document.

entrypoints.name: Example
entrypoints.plain: TypedDict for one OpenAPI 'example' object, used by Body()/Query()/etc. to accept example values.

entrypoints.name: SecurityBase
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for an OpenAPI security scheme, used inside the generated document (distinct from security.SecurityBase, the runtime scheme class).

entrypoints.name: OAuth2
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for an OpenAPI OAuth2 security scheme.

entrypoints.name: APIKey
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for an OpenAPI API-key security scheme.

entrypoints.name: HTTPBase
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for an OpenAPI HTTP auth security scheme (Basic/Bearer/Digest).

entrypoints.name: OpenIdConnect
entrypoints.plain: Pydantic model for an OpenAPI OpenID Connect security scheme.

units.name: security
units.description: Provides FastAPI's authentication/authorization building blocks as dependency-injectable classes: API-key extraction from query/header/cookie, HTTP Basic/Bearer/Digest credential parsing, and OAuth2 password/authorization-code flows including the SecurityScopes helper used to declare required scopes. Each class both extracts credentials from the request and documents the corresponding OpenAPI security scheme.

entrypoints.name: SecurityBase
entrypoints.plain: Base class every security scheme implements; carries the OpenAPI model and scheme name.

entrypoints.name: APIKeyQuery
entrypoints.plain: Dependency that extracts an API key from a query parameter.

entrypoints.name: APIKeyHeader
entrypoints.plain: Dependency that extracts an API key from a request header.

entrypoints.name: APIKeyCookie
entrypoints.plain: Dependency that extracts an API key from a cookie.

entrypoints.name: HTTPBasic
entrypoints.plain: Dependency that extracts and decodes HTTP Basic Authorization credentials.

entrypoints.name: HTTPBearer
entrypoints.plain: Dependency that extracts an HTTP Bearer token from the Authorization header.

entrypoints.name: HTTPDigest
entrypoints.plain: Dependency that extracts HTTP Digest Authorization credentials.

entrypoints.name: OAuth2
entrypoints.plain: Base OAuth2 dependency that reads the bearer token and documents an OAuth2 OpenAPI scheme.

entrypoints.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
entrypoints.plain: OAuth2 password-flow dependency; documents the token URL for the docs UI's login form.

entrypoints.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
entrypoints.plain: OAuth2 authorization-code-flow dependency.

entrypoints.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
entrypoints.plain: Form-body dependency matching the OAuth2 password-flow request shape (username, password, scope, ...).

entrypoints.name: SecurityScopes
entrypoints.plain: Injected into a dependency to read the OAuth2 scopes required by the current endpoint.

entrypoints.name: OpenIdConnect
entrypoints.plain: Dependency/documentation for an OpenID Connect discovery-URL security scheme.

entrypoints.name: get_authorization_scheme_param
entrypoints.plain: Splits an 'Authorization: <scheme> <param>' header value into its two parts.

units.name: middleware
units.description: ASGI middleware for FastAPI applications. AsyncExitStackMiddleware opens the per-request AsyncExitStack that dependency teardown relies on; the rest of the files are thin re-exports of Starlette's CORS, GZip, HTTPS-redirect, trusted-host, and WSGI middlewares so applications can `from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware` etc. without importing starlette directly.

entrypoints.name: AsyncExitStackMiddleware
entrypoints.plain: Opens an AsyncExitStack per request, stored on the ASGI scope, so generator dependencies can register teardown.

entrypoints.name: Middleware
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's Middleware config wrapper used in FastAPI(middleware=[...]).

entrypoints.name: CORSMiddleware
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's CORS middleware.

entrypoints.name: GZipMiddleware
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's response-compression middleware.

entrypoints.name: HTTPSRedirectMiddleware
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect middleware.

entrypoints.name: TrustedHostMiddleware
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's Host-header allowlist middleware.

entrypoints.name: WSGIMiddleware
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's adapter for mounting a WSGI app inside an ASGI app.

units.name: static-templating
units.description: Re-exports Starlette's StaticFiles and Jinja2Templates so applications can serve static assets and render server-side HTML templates via `fastapi.staticfiles`/`fastapi.templating` without importing starlette directly.
units.role: Serving static files and rendering HTML templates.

entrypoints.name: StaticFiles
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's ASGI app that serves files from a directory on disk.

entrypoints.name: Jinja2Templates
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's Jinja2 template renderer, which loads template files from disk.

effects.description: StaticFiles serves files from a directory on disk and Jinja2Templates loads template files from disk (both re-exported from Starlette); not caught by plain-text scanning since this file contains only an import line, but real at runtime.

units.name: testclient
units.description: Re-exports Starlette's TestClient so application test suites can `from fastapi.testclient import TestClient` without importing starlette directly. TestClient drives the ASGI app in-process (via httpx) to simulate real HTTP requests in tests.
units.role: In-process HTTP client for testing FastAPI apps.

entrypoints.name: TestClient
entrypoints.plain: Sends simulated HTTP requests directly into an ASGI app for use in tests.

effects.description: TestClient (re-exported from Starlette, backed by httpx) sends requests through the same client/transport machinery httpx uses for real network calls, even though it is normally wired to an in-process ASGI transport rather than a socket.

units.name: pydantic-compat
units.description: Isolates FastAPI's dependence on Pydantic's field/schema internals behind a stable internal interface (ModelField and a set of introspection/schema-generation functions), re-exported from _compat/__init__.py. shared.py holds annotation-inspection helpers usable regardless of Pydantic version; v2.py implements them against Pydantic v2's FieldInfo/GenerateJsonSchema APIs. Every other unit that needs to inspect a type annotation or build a JSON schema goes through this layer instead of importing pydantic internals directly.
units.role: Stable internal interface to Pydantic's model/schema machinery.

entrypoints.name: ModelField
entrypoints.plain: FastAPI's wrapper around a Pydantic FieldInfo plus its name/annotation, used throughout as the unit of 'one validated field'.

entrypoints.name: get_definitions
entrypoints.plain: Builds the OpenAPI component schema definitions for a set of ModelFields.

entrypoints.name: get_schema_from_model_field
entrypoints.plain: Builds the OpenAPI schema fragment for a single ModelField.

entrypoints.name: evaluate_forwardref

entrypoints.name: create_body_model
entrypoints.plain: Synthesizes a Pydantic model class to represent a request body assembled from multiple Body() fields.

entrypoints.name: copy_field_info
entrypoints.plain: Copies a FieldInfo, applying a (possibly different) annotation.

entrypoints.name: get_cached_model_fields
entrypoints.plain: Returns (and memoizes) the list of ModelFields for a Pydantic model class.

entrypoints.name: Undefined
entrypoints.plain: Sentinel for 'no default given', aliased to Pydantic's own undefined marker.

entrypoints.name: with_info_plain_validator_function
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of pydantic_core's helper for building a core schema from a plain validator function.

entrypoints.name: lenient_issubclass
entrypoints.plain: issubclass() that returns False instead of raising for non-class arguments.

entrypoints.name: field_annotation_is_scalar
entrypoints.plain: Checks whether a type annotation denotes a single scalar value (as opposed to a sequence/mapping/model).

entrypoints.name: field_annotation_is_sequence
entrypoints.plain: Checks whether a type annotation denotes a sequence type.

entrypoints.name: annotation_is_pydantic_v1
entrypoints.plain: Detects a legacy Pydantic v1 BaseModel annotation so callers can raise PydanticV1NotSupportedError.

entrypoints.name: Url
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Pydantic's URL type used by jsonable_encoder to recognize URL values.

units.name: runtime-utils
units.description: Small cross-cutting helpers used throughout the framework: shared typing aliases (types.py), the 'fastapi' stdlib logger instance (logger.py), thread-pool helpers for running blocking code from async endpoints (concurrency.py), and generic utility functions such as operation-ID generation, path-parameter-name extraction, and building a ModelField for a raw parameter (utils.py).
units.role: Generic helpers with no framework-specific domain logic of their own.

entrypoints.plain: TypeVar bound to Callable, used to type path-operation decorators so they preserve the wrapped function's signature.

entrypoints.name: IncEx

entrypoints.name: ModelNameMap
entrypoints.plain: Type alias for the dict mapping a model/enum class to its OpenAPI component name.

entrypoints.name: DependencyCacheKey
entrypoints.plain: Type alias for the key used to cache a resolved dependency's value within one request.

entrypoints.name: logger
entrypoints.plain: The 'fastapi' standard-library logger instance shared across the framework.

entrypoints.name: run_in_threadpool
entrypoints.plain: Re-export of Starlette's helper to run a blocking callable off the event loop.

entrypoints.name: contextmanager_in_threadpool
entrypoints.plain: Runs a synchronous context manager's __enter__/__exit__ in a thread pool, used for sync generator dependencies.

entrypoints.name: is_body_allowed_for_status_code
entrypoints.plain: Returns whether an HTTP status code permits a response body (e.g. false for 204/304).

entrypoints.name: get_path_param_names
entrypoints.plain: Extracts the {name} placeholders from a route's path template.

entrypoints.name: create_model_field
entrypoints.plain: Builds a ModelField for a raw name/type/default, used for parameters not already backed by a Pydantic model field.

entrypoints.name: generate_operation_id_for_path
entrypoints.plain: Computes the default OpenAPI operationId for one route (deprecated legacy scheme).

entrypoints.name: generate_unique_id
entrypoints.plain: Default unique-ID generator FastAPI uses for each route's operationId.

entrypoints.name: deep_dict_update
entrypoints.plain: Recursively merges one dict into another in place, used to merge OpenAPI schema fragments.

entrypoints.name: get_value_or_default
entrypoints.plain: Picks the first explicitly-set value among several DefaultPlaceholder-wrapped candidates, falling back to a default.
